title: A Home Assistant cover: a garage door, gate, door, shutter or blind

alert.detail.description: An alert design's explanation and what to do; empty when nothing is wrong.

alert.help_url.description: Where an alert's Help goes: an HTTPS page the host chooses; empty for none.

alert.message.description: An alert design's headline (`Left open for 30 minutes`); empty when nothing is wrong.

card.title.description: The card's own `title:`, when it has one.

cover.s0.battery.description: The battery level of the door's tilt or contact sensor, 0 to 100; -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

cover.s0.current_position.description: How far open, 0 closed to 100 open; -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

cover.s0.current_tilt_position.description: A tilting cover's slat tilt, 0 closed to 100 open; -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

cover.s0.device_class.description: What kind of cover: `garage`, `gate`, `door`, `shutter`, `blind`, `awning`; empty when unset.

cover.s0.is_available.description: False while the entity is unavailable or missing.

cover.s0.is_on.description: Whether Home Assistant counts the state as on.

cover.s0.last_changed.description: When the state last changed, in whole Unix seconds; 0 when unknown.

cover.s0.last_changed_offset.description: The UTC offset in force at last_changed in the host's time zone, in seconds.

cover.s0.light_on.description: The opener's own light is on, for openers that have one; false otherwise.

cover.s0.locked.description: The opener is locked out (vacation mode, a lock entity on the same device); false when there is none.

cover.s0.name.description: The door's name: the card's `name:`, else its friendly name.

cover.s0.obstructed.description: An obstruction sensor on the same device reports something in the way; false when there is none.

cover.s0.picture.description: A picture of the device: a camera snapshot for a real-world design, else the entity's own picture, as `app:` or `https:` (PROTOCOL.md §6.1). Absent when the host has none; the design shows its own drawing.

cover.s0.state.description: Its state as Home Assistant formats it for display, in the person's language (`Closed`, `Heat`).

cover.s0.state_int.description: The state as a key: 0 closed, 1 open, 2 opening, 3 closing, 4 unavailable, 5 unknown (HaLiveBindings.coverStateInt).

cover.s0.supported_features.description: Home Assistant's supported_features bitmask: 1 open, 2 close, 4 set position, 8 stop, 16+ tilt; -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

host.ambient.description: The host's ambient flag: 1 while its display is in a low-power always-on state, 0 otherwise. Every Home Assistant card reads it to draw its ambient look (docs/architecture/ambient-mode.md).

toggle.description: Open it if closed, close it if open: a single push button.

set_position.description: The person moved its position (bit 4): the host calls set_cover_position.

more_info.description: Open Home Assistant's more-info dialog for the entity.

help.description: Open alert.help_url, on hosts the app allowlists.

ha.description: A card's own tap, as Home Assistant's cards emit it: the host decodes the payload, an encoded HaAction (toggle, more-info, a service call, navigate), and runs it.

obstructed.cover.s0.name: Garage door
obstructed.alert.detail: The door stopped closing at 60 %. Clear the doorway, then close it again.

left-open.cover.s0.name: Garage door
left-open.alert.detail: The door has been open since 18:05. Close it, or check the camera.
